description:
After an artifact is published via `apply` or `set-current`, LPBS does not notify any other system. Add a webhook mechanism (configurable URL per app or per bundle) that fires on artifact promotion, enabling deployment-manager and other systems to react to publish events rather than polling.

Source: research/desktop-release-control-plane-audit conclusion — Finding 9 gap #1.
name: lpbs-publish-webhook
title: Add webhook/event notification on LPBS artifact publish
